summary: The `ansible.builtin.su` become plugin lets the login user run commands as another user via the su utility.
questions: How do I use su instead of sudo for privilege escalation?
What does the su become plugin do?

answer_card.title: ansible.builtin.su become plugin
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.su` (become plugin, ansible-core 2.22) lets your remote/login user execute commands as another user via the `su` utility.
